name: Leer (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Leer (Ostfriesland) (a white letter L between stars and a rose on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Leer; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Leer arms — letter L, stars and rose on blue
